examples.english: In the past, oxen carried loads.

notes:
{牛|うし} refers to cattle.

READINGS:
- うし: standalone word for cow/cattle
- ぎゅう: in compounds (e.g., {牛肉|ぎゅうにく})

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {牛肉|ぎゅうにく}: beef
- {牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}: milk
- {乳牛|にゅうぎゅう}: dairy cow
- {子牛|こうし}: calf

COUNTER:
- {一頭|いっとう}、{二頭|にとう} (counter for large animals)
